en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a townscape with a tall stone clock/bell tower on the left, a curved road and low wall in the foreground, and a park or open grounds with several classical-style buildings in the middle distance. Trees frame much of the scene. Along the bottom margin are printed captions in Greek and English identifying the location as Chania (Canea) in Crete and noting it as a partial view. There is also a website watermark and a handwritten signature or printer's mark.
